subject: ⚡️ Zelenskyy: I has offered Fedorov several positions
posts: Zelenskyy frames the offer to Fedorov as a strategic move for military innovation, but the former minister sees it as a loss of real power. Evidence: Innovation, Power Consolidation, Strategic Realignment. #Ukraine #Zelenskyy
Zelenskyy claims he offered Fedorov the deputy PM role to coordinate military innovation with the Ministry of Defence. Stated Judgement: (+0.8, +0.5) — Good Preference
Fedorov rejects the role, noting it lacks the actual authority needed to implement his strategy, revealing a power struggle. Resulting Judgement: (+0.2, +0.3) — Lesser Good
Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception. The stated goal of innovation masks a struggle over executive control and ministerial authority. Integrity: Partially Distorted (R_net: 2.5, Uncertainty z: 3)
President Zelenskyy is attempting to reassign former defense minister Mykhailo Fedorov to a new role, but Fedorov is resisting, citing a lack of necessary authority.

The Bright Side:
Public transparency regarding the disagreement shows that the government is still debating strategy rather than just rubber-stamping decisions.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a HOW error. The stated goal (innovation) is disconnected from the actual mechanism (the lack of executive power in the proposed role).

Social Physics Analysis:
Zelenskyy uses the pretext of 'innovation' to manage a political transition. Fedorov’s refusal exposes the gap between the title of the role and the actual capacity to effect change.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Good. The move is a political compromise that risks stalling actual progress.

The Unavoidable Truth: Fedorov believes he cannot stop Russia without the specific powers of the Ministry of Defence.

The Unavoidable Lie: The new role provides the necessary authority to coordinate military innovation effectively.

Alethekanon:
This is a structural power play. Zelenskyy is attempting to integrate a key player into a new hierarchy, but the player recognizes the loss of agency.

Awwthekanon:
It is so difficult when talented people feel their hands are tied. I hope they find a way to work together for the sake of the country.

Brothekanon:
Zelenskyy is trying to keep the band together, but Fedorov knows a demotion when he sees one. Politics as usual.
